reviewers.summary: The previously reported telemetry exposure and item-level package manager issues appear fixed. The new validation test does not catch regressions in batch-level package_manager validation.

findingList.message: The malformed-batch contract test does not cover an unsupported batch-level package_manager, although the criterion requires validation of both the batch and item fields. Add a case with package_manager="freebsd" on the batch.

evidence.codePathTraced: The test varies item.package_manager but always sets the batch-level package_manager to "apt". It never exercises the new batch-level validation at updates.py:107-109.
evidence.failureScenario: If batch-level package_manager validation is removed and a batch with package_manager="freebsd" is accepted, every case in test_malformed_batch_contract still passes.

reviewers.summary: The added tests cover the main batch endpoint and several malformed item cases, but miss the ingest endpoint’s telemetry contract and batch-level package-manager rejection.

findingList.message: The observability contract test does not exercise the ingest route, so it does not prove the criterion that both batch routes emit the required metrics.

evidence.codePathTraced: The named observability test sends requests only to /api/v1/updates/batch. The acceptance criterion also requires metrics from /api/v1/updates/ingest/{package_manager}.
evidence.failureScenario: If the ingest route stops recording its row, transaction, or request-duration metrics, this test still passes because it never calls that route.

findingList.message: The malformed-batch test does not cover an unsupported batch-level package_manager, leaving that required validation path untested.

evidence.codePathTraced: Every parameterized request sets the batch-level package_manager to apt; the cases vary only the item. The acceptance criterion requires rejecting unsupported package_manager values at both the batch and item levels before SQL runs.
evidence.failureScenario: If batch-level package_manager validation is removed, a request with package_manager set to freebsd can proceed to database work, while every case in test_malformed_batch_contract still passes.

reviewers.summary: The round 3 changes remove the hostname metric label and reject unsupported package_manager values before batch processing. I found no reachable security defect in the scoped changes.
